sentences.en: The candidate was disappointed at the outcome of the election.
sentences.zh: 这位候选人对选举的结果感到失望。

sentences.en: This and many other causes led to the fatal outcome.
sentences.zh: 多种原因导致了这场灾难性的结果。

sentences.en: Innocent people are dying without any favourable outcome in sight.
sentences.zh: 无辜的人们在看不到任何有利结果的情况下不断死去。
